title: Gaming
tagline: GTA VI's launch, the reviews and what everyone's playing, through to The Game Awards.
subject: Pop culture

briefing.headline: GTA 6 is now out worldwide on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and it has a near-perfect 99 Metacritic score.

points.text: Rockstar says GTA 6 is now available worldwide on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
points.label: reported

points.text: GTA 6 has a near-perfect 99 on Metacritic. IGN says only Zelda has scored as high.
points.label: reported

points.text: Sales have already passed Christopher Nolan's film 'The Odyssey', The Hollywood Reporter says.
points.label: reported

points.text: Reviewers and streamers are sharing early gameplay. IGN has videos on Xbox Series X, Series S and PS5 performance.
points.label: reported

points.text: A 6-star wanted level is back, and one guide says only one way exists to lose the cops at that level.
points.label: reported
